text: {"lessons":["A strong gain in Stock D is not proof it will keep rising; I should base decisions on its future prospects and role in my portfolio.","Taking some profit can feel satisfying, but I should avoid selling solely to lock in a gain or because my average cost makes the return look large.","I made no trades in most periods, which is reasonable when there is no clear case to act; I should check diversification and risk periodically without reacting to random price changes."]}
